description: Figure 16 presents a bar chart illustrating Shapley values averaged over 247 tasks, categorized by relative position to the probed target word. The horizontal axis displays the relative positions labeled L₄, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄, arranged from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Shapley value”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 10.  Three sets of bars are displayed for each position: mBERT (blue), XLM-R (green), and chLSTM (purple). For each position, the bars are grouped side-by-side, representing the Shapley value for each model. The tallest bar is at position T for mBERT, reaching approximately 74. The shortest bar is at position L₄ for chLSTM, with a value of approximately 4.  Generally, the mBERT bars are the tallest, followed by XLM-R, and then chLSTM, though this varies by position. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations, and the bars are not sorted in any apparent order.
